description: Forward one of my DCAST streams to YouTube, Twitch, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Kick or custom RTMP; Instagram, TikTok, Kick and custom RTMP need rtmp_url (Instagram only rtmps://). Destination keys are sent to DCAST and are not echoed back.

destinations.description: Platforms to forward the stream to, 1 to 20

platform.description: CUSTOM, YOUTUBE, TWITCH, FACEBOOK, INSTAGRAM, TIKTOK, KICK or TELEGRAM

rtmp_url.description: Ingest URL of the destination; needed for INSTAGRAM (rtmps:// only), TIKTOK, KICK and CUSTOM

stream_key.description: Stream key issued by the destination platform

name: create_restream
title: Create a restream
